description: AWS Security AgentCore Chatbot - Phase 4 Gateway Integration
context:
Successfully completed Phase 4 Gateway Integration tasks:

✅ Task 4.1a: Created AgentCore Gateway construct - Gateway created with URL: https://security-chatbot-gateway-b8f1ace7-sgstucfbla.gateway.bedrock-agentcore.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/mcp
✅ Task 4.1b: Configured OAuth2 authentication - Cognito User Pool and OAuth client created with client ID: 13sub54edthvj9k548e9l35rfd
✅ Task 4.1c: Set up MCP protocol support - Gateway configured with Lambda target pointing to security-roi-analytics-security-mcp function
✅ Task 4.1d: Deployed gateway - Gateway successfully deployed and operational
✅ Task 4.2a: Tested gateway authentication flow - Successfully obtained OAuth access tokens
✅ Task 4.2b: Validated MCP server connectivity - Gateway connects to Lambda function and lists 7 available tools

ARCHITECTURE INSIGHT: Gateway exposes tools with prefixed names (SecurityMCPTools___ToolName) and connects to Lambda functions via MCP protocol. External agents can now authenticate via OAuth and call security tools through the Gateway.

REMAINING ISSUE: Lambda function expects 'tool_name' parameter but Gateway sends different format. Need to update Lambda handler for Gateway compatibility.

RESET: Deleted incorrect Lambda approach that deviated from original architecture. 

ISSUE: Created Gateway → Lambda instead of following original design: Gateway → AgentCore Runtime MCP Server.

CORRECTIVE ACTION: Going back to original architecture. Need to connect Gateway to existing AgentCore Runtime MCP server from Phase 3, not create separate Lambda functions.

ALL TASKS RESET TO PENDING - will implement correctly following original design.

ARCHITECTURE CLARIFICATION: 

Original design shows Gateway connects to MCP Server, NOT to AgentCore Runtime.
- AgentCore Runtime hosts complete agents
- MCP Server is standalone service with security tools
- Gateway calls MCP Server endpoints

Need to deploy MCP Server as standalone service (Lambda or container) that Gateway can reach via HTTP endpoint.

✅ PHASE 4 GATEWAY INTEGRATION COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY!

CRITICAL LESSON LEARNED: Never deviate from original architecture. Always refer to official samples and documentation.

MISTAKE MADE: Initially tried to use Lambda targets and mcpServer with runtimeArn parameter, which failed with error: 'mcpServer target type requires endpoint parameter, not runtimeArn'

CORRECT SOLUTION DISCOVERED:
1. Runtime ARN: arn:aws:bedrock-agentcore:us-east-1:039920874011:runtime/agentcore_mcp_server-CmiD0a32zF
2. Correct endpoint URL format: https://agentcore_mcp_server-CmiD0a32zF.runtime.bedrock-agentcore.us-east-1.amazonaws.com
3. Used mcpServer target type with endpoint parameter (not runtimeArn)
4. Fixed OAuth configuration with IAM permissions

FINAL WORKING CONFIGURATION:
- Gateway URL: https://security-chatbot-gateway-41f3cc60-fmqz5lmy6j.gateway.bedrock-agentcore.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/mcp
- Target ID: FYLX5BCCSF
- 7 Security tools successfully exposed through Gateway
- MCP protocol working correctly
- OAuth authentication functional

ARCHITECTURE INTEGRITY MAINTAINED: Gateway → AgentCore Runtime → MCP Server (no Lambda shortcuts)
